verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs point to a dedicated AI solutions page and concrete integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK, AgentCore serverless workers) that let developers embed AI agent/LLM calls as steps inside a durable workflow, with tool use handled by those SDKs. However, there's no first-party documentation on model selection mechanics, no code sample showing 'model choice' configuration, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that these integrations work smoothly in practice — missing for 10: concrete model-selection API/config docs, worked code example of an LLM step with tool calls, and community validation of the AI integrations.
